title: Sheng-Yun Brian Yu CV
subtitle: Applied AI Engineer / Full-Stack Product Engineer

description.intro: Currently an AI Engineer, turning Claude and content-moderation capabilities into shipped product features. Independently built a dating-matching and interest-based meetup app, covering requirement planning, prompt design, backend services, and the iOS release. Eight years of software development experience, primarily in Node.js and TypeScript (NestJS / React), using a single language across frontend and backend, with sustained work on refactoring, test coverage, and performance optimization. Previously led an 11-person engineering team delivering 12 game products, with hands-on experience in real-time interaction and high-concurrency scenarios.
